result: Every 2-block-positive member of the following 4x4 diagonal-minus-correlated-projector family is decomposable, hence nonnegative on every PPT state. Parameters vary continuously and the diagonal metric need not factor as A tensor B. The family includes cyclic diagonal-type witnesses and genuinely non-PSD, non-coPSD 2-block-positive examples. This is a witness-family no-go, not a proof that every 4x4 PPT state has Schmidt number at most 2.
family: Let e_ij=|i,j>, omega=sum_(i=0)^3 e_ii, and [x]=|x><x|. For kappa>=0, real t, and d_ij>=0 for i!=j, set W=t*sum_i[e_ii]+sum_(i!=j)d_ij[e_ij]-kappa[omega]. Require d_01*d_10=d_23*d_32, d_02*d_20=d_13*d_31, and d_03*d_30=d_12*d_21. These are exactly equality of the geometric means q_ij=sqrt(d_ij*d_ji) along each complementary pair in each perfect matching of four vertices. In particular, d_(i,i+s)=a_s cyclically is included.
necessary_tests: The rank-two vector e_ii+e_jj gives 2t-4kappa>=0, hence t>=2kappa. For any perfect matching {i,j},{k,l}, take the coefficient matrix X with all four diagonal entries 1, entries X_ij=u, X_ji=1/u, X_kl=v, X_lk=1/v, all other entries zero. It is a direct sum of two rank-one 2x2 blocks and has rank two. Its expectation is 4t-16kappa+d_ij|u|^2+d_ji|u|^(-2)+d_kl|v|^2+d_lk|v|^(-2). Infimizing positive |u|,|v| gives 4t-16kappa+2(q_ij+q_kl)>=0, including the limiting case of zero coefficients. By the matching equalities q_ij=q_kl, each of the three matchings forces q_ij>=4kappa-t. No sufficiency of these tests for 2-block positivity is claimed or needed.
decomposition: If kappa=0, the rank-two test forces t>=0 and W is PSD. If t>=4kappa, the correlated diagonal sector t I_4-kappa J_4 and all other diagonal sectors are PSD, so W is PSD. Otherwise 2kappa<=t<4kappa. Put delta=4kappa-t>0; all q_ij>=delta. Let B be the direct sum over i<j, on basis (e_ij,e_ji), of (delta/q_ij)*[[d_ij,-q_ij],[-q_ij,d_ji]]. Each block is PSD of determinant zero. Set A=W-B^Gamma. On off-diagonal basis vectors A is diagonal with coefficients d_ij*(1-delta/q_ij)>=0. On span{e_00,e_11,e_22,e_33}, A has diagonal t-kappa and off-diagonal delta-kappa; its all-ones eigenvalue is 2delta and its other three eigenvalues are t-delta=2t-4kappa>=0. Thus A,B>=0 and W=A+B^Gamma. The construction is explicit and works for every allowed real parameter, including boundaries.
nontrivial_exact_example: Take kappa=1, t=7/2 and all d_ij=1/2. Then W=(1/2)I_16+3 sum_i[e_ii]-[omega]. For every rank<=2 coefficient matrix X, |tr X|^2<=2||X||_F^2 and |tr X|^2<=4 sum_i|X_ii|^2; averaging the first with weight 1/4 and the second with weight 3/4 proves <X|W|X>>=0. Yet <omega|W|omega>=-2 and <e_01+e_10|W^Gamma|e_01+e_10>=-1, so W is neither PSD nor coPSD. The displayed decomposition specializes to B=(1/2)sum_(i<j)[e_ij-e_ji], A=3 sum_i[e_ii]-(1/2)[omega]. Its diagonal positive metric is not a product metric: t^2!=d_01*d_10.

exact_check.observed: Fraction arithmetic checks all 256 decomposition entries, A PSD rank 4, B PSD rank 6, and the indicated negative W and W^Gamma test values. The universal parameter proof and the SR2 trace inequalities are written arguments, not finite-example inference.

limits: The three complementary-pair geometric-mean equalities are essential hypotheses of the displayed proof; arbitrary diagonal coefficients are not covered. WRITTEN plus exact rational example replay. No claim of novelty, independent review, general indecomposable-map classification, or 4x4 PPT/SN3 resolution.
